settings.heading: Turn your wardrobe into store credit
settings.text: Have good-quality clothes you no longer wear? Send them our way. We photograph, list and pack each piece, and you earn store credit when it sells.

settings.title: Tell us what you have
settings.text: Fill in the form below with a short description of your items.

settings.title: We review
settings.text: We reply within 2 business days with what we can accept and the credit on offer.

settings.title: Send or drop off
settings.text: Post your parcel in reused packaging, or arrange a drop-off in Auckland.

settings.title: Earn credit
settings.text: When your pieces sell, store credit lands in your account to spend on your next find.

settings.heading: Tell us what you would like to sell
settings.text: We accept clean, good-quality women's, men's and unisex clothing and accessories.
